segments.note: Given/when/then jointly retain the layer exclusion, exact properties, length threshold, and non-zero duration prohibition; verifier detail repeats them.
The why retains the unchosen scale-step example and cumulative erosion rationale.
The heading is absorbed into prefer[0], retaining the canonical existing-foundations path.
The avoid structure carries the prohibitory heading's meaning, with all three anti-patterns retained.

activation.note: Repository-wide design-root prerequisite, UI-file scope, layer exclusions, declaration thresholds, and literal-only TS/MTS handling match the source. Examples illustrate the same scope; stated detector extension coverage is a declared addition explicitly distinguished from normative applicability. Observer labels conservatively acknowledge repository/UI classification and finding needs rather than claiming unsupported observation.

audit.summary: All 44 segments survive at their claimed destinations without decision-relevant loss. Exceptions remain source-authored, then expresses one token-sourcing obligation, and the shared strict-disposition node is generic and contains the claimed content.

segmentChecks.note: Given, when, then, and unless jointly preserve the design-root scope, tokens/foundations exclusion, exact property set, greater-than-1px length threshold, and non-zero duration prohibition.
The why field retains the 13px example, the unchosen scale step, and the cumulative erosion rationale with only grammatical compression.
The Canonical path heading is safely absorbed into prefer[0], which supplies its actual normative content.
The avoid list preserves the prohibitory force of Do not broaden and all three prohibited behaviors.
Strict disposition is present verbatim in the shared policy.strict-disposition node and is also retained in verifier_detail[8].
The when field and verifier_detail[2] preserve inline style attributes, style-element text, .ts/.mts files, and string/template/tagged-template HTML literals.
The repository-wide no-design-root exemption and its rationale survive in activation, unless[5], and verifier_detail[4].
The definition of a visual token as a once-defined foundations spacing/radius/motion value referenced with var(--…) survives in verifier_detail[5] and evidence[1].
The rewrite preserves general UI-file scope and explicitly includes primitives and components; the added extension list is clearly limited to current detector coverage.
Prefer[2] retains both the GREEN qualifier and the requirement that a genuinely distinct current design need justify a new foundation value.
Verifier_detail[3] preserves the literal-only .ts/.mts rule, exclusions for code/comments/regex literals, and independent judging of literal chunks around interpolation.

risks: The coder-facing fields do not explicitly explain the unusual edge case of a value split across a ${…} interpolation; that detail is available only in verifier_detail, although the main implementation decision remains clear.

unobservable: path_glob requires a repository-level existence observer for any design root, rather than an ordinary fact about the judged file.
file_kind requires a UI-file classifier; 'any format that carries style declarations' has no deterministic extension allowlist or observer.
finding requires the bun_design_system_detector or an equivalent declaration-parsing observer.

review.summary: The rewrite is lossless at the checked destinations, including the shared strict-disposition node, and gives a weak coder a clear token-sourcing decision with the relevant exceptions. Activation semantics match the source, but deterministic execution still depends on new repository-scope, UI-classification, and detector observers; this does not warrant failing the rewrite.
